_meta.note: One turn whose model stub answers HTTP 503 on every request, so codex-acp gives up and ends the session/prompt with stopReason end_turn and usage null: a turn the provider billed nothing reports no token counts. Driven over stdio by the harness probe rig against a loopback Responses-API model stub with Crew's own initialize params; no real model or credential was involved. The adapter is the Real Adapter Contract lane's pinned build (test/real_adapters/package.json). Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, with these reductions at capture: models.availableModels is emptied; 6 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 4 available_commands_update/session_info_update frame(s) dropped: they carry the recording host's own command inventory and run id; the session id is replaced with the synthetic codex-session-1; the loopback model stub's URL origin is replaced with <model-stub>.
